source.title: ERA5 hourly data on single levels (ECMWF, Copernicus Climate Change Service), ARCO ERA5 raw files on Google Cloud
source.note: 10 m wind, 10 m gust, snow depth, lake ice depth and 2 m temperature, November to May, read with HTTP range requests from https://storage.googleapis.com/gcp-public-data-arco-era5/raw/date-variable-single_level/YYYY/MM/DD/<variable>/surface.nc; lake cover, high vegetation cover, land sea mask and surface geopotential from https://storage.googleapis.com/gcp-public-data-arco-era5/raw/date-variable-static/2021/12/31/<variable>/static.nc. Hersbach et al. (2020), ERA5, doi:10.24381/cds.adbb2d47. A model on a grid of about 31 km; values describe a grid cell. Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information.
